name: Nyuuin
source:
A day before entrance to the university hero is hit by a car and hospitalized.

But these three weeks of his life will be an unforgettable experience. Maybe he can even find love there?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大学入学的前一天，主角被车撞了，住进了医院。但这三周的人生将成为一段难忘的经历。或许他还能在那里找到爱情？

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
